cc_desc.zh: 粘贴文本即可实时统计字符、词、句、段与阅读时长，中英文混合自动识别。纯浏览器本地处理，文本不上传。
cc_desc.en: Paste text for live character, word, sentence, paragraph, and reading-time counts, with automatic zh/en/mixed detection. Runs locally; text is never uploaded.

cc_sample_text.zh:
字数统计器是作家、学生、内容创作者每天都用到的工具。

无论是写邮件、写论文、发微博，还是准备演讲稿、翻译文档，快速了解文本长度都能帮你判断节奏、把握时长。

本工具实时统计字符、词、句、段与阅读/朗读时长，中英文混合自动识别。

Your text will never leave your browser.
cc_sample_text.en:
A word counter is a daily tool for writers, students, and content creators.

Whether you're drafting an email, writing a paper, posting on social media, preparing a speech, or translating a document, a quick look at the length helps you control pace and estimate time.

This tool counts characters, words, sentences, paragraphs, and reading/speaking time in real time, with automatic zh/en/mixed detection.

Your text will never leave your browser.

cc_placeholder.zh: 在此粘贴或输入要统计的文本…

cc_how_1.zh: 粘贴文本：把要统计的内容贴进上方输入框，右侧会实时刷新所有指标。
cc_how_1.en: Paste text: drop your content into the input box; the panel on the right updates live.

cc_how_2.zh: 看主要语言：顶部显示检测到的主要语言（中文 / 英文 / 混合 / 空白），用于判断阅读时长按哪边算。
cc_how_2.en: Check the dominant language: the top of the panel shows the detected language (Chinese / English / Mixed / Empty), which determines how reading time is estimated.

cc_how_3.zh: 看时长估算：阅读按中文 400 字/分钟、英文 200 词/分钟；朗读按中文 220 字/分钟、英文 150 词/分钟估算。
cc_how_3.en: Look at the time estimates: reading uses 400 CJK chars/min and 200 English words/min; speaking uses 220 CJK/min and 150 English wpm.

cc_how_4.zh: 复制摘要：一键复制「共 X 字 / Y 词 / Z 段 / 阅读约 A 分」的简报，便于贴到社交平台。
cc_how_4.en: Copy the summary: one click copies a short blurb ("X chars / Y words / Z paragraphs / ~A min read") ready to paste into social posts.

cc_faq_1_q.zh: 文本会被上传到服务器吗？
cc_faq_1_q.en: Is my text uploaded to a server?

cc_faq_1_a.zh: 不会。所有统计都基于浏览器本地字符串运算（正则 + 计数器），不发生任何网络请求，文本离开浏览器窗口即无残留。
cc_faq_1_a.en: No. All counts are computed locally in your browser via regex and simple counters; no network requests are made, and nothing persists after you close the tab.

cc_faq_2_a.zh: 使用 Unicode CJK 统一汉字区段（U+4E00–U+9FFF）和扩展 A 区段（U+3400–U+4DBF）识别，中文标点不计入字数但会计入总字符。
cc_faq_2_a.en: Characters are recognized from the CJK Unified Ideographs range (U+4E00–U+9FFF) and Extension A (U+3400–U+4DBF). Chinese punctuation is not counted as a character, but does count toward the total character count.

cc_faq_3_a.zh: 连续字母或数字串算一个词，支持缩写（Mary's）与数字（3.14、1,000）。中文标点不影响英文词的判定。
cc_faq_3_a.en: A run of letters or digits counts as one word. Abbreviations (Mary's) and numbers (3.14, 1,000) are supported. Chinese punctuation does not affect English word detection.

cc_faq_4_q.zh: 阅读/朗读时长的依据是什么？
cc_faq_4_q.en: What are the reading/speaking time rates based on?

cc_faq_4_a.zh: 阅读按成人英文读物平均速度 200 wpm、中文平均阅读速度 400 字/分钟；朗读按英文 150 wpm、中文 220 字/分钟（新闻播报级）。实际速度因人而异，仅供估算参考。
cc_faq_4_a.en: Reading uses 200 wpm for English (adult reading average) and 400 CJK chars/min; speaking uses 150 English wpm and 220 CJK/min (news broadcast pace). Individual speeds vary — treat these as estimates.

cc_summary_template.zh: 共 {cjk} 中文字 / {words} 英文词 / {para} 段，阅读约 {read}
cc_summary_template.en: {cjk} Chinese chars / {words} English words / {para} paragraphs, ~{read} to read
